test_cases.question: What are the tasks of the Chair of the European Data Protection Board?
test_cases.answer: The Chair shall have the following tasks: (a) to convene the meetings of the Board and prepare its agenda; (b) to notify decisions adopted by the Board pursuant to Article 65 to the lead supervisory authority and the supervisory authorities concerned; and (c) to ensure the timely performance of the tasks of the Board, in particular in relation to the consistency mechanism referred to in Article 63.

test_cases.question: Who receives notification of decisions adopted by the Board?
test_cases.answer: The Chair notifies decisions adopted by the Board pursuant to Article 65 to the lead supervisory authority and the supervisory authorities concerned. This ensures all relevant SAs are informed of binding dispute resolution decisions.
test_cases.supporting_quote: to notify decisions adopted by the Board pursuant to Article 65 to the lead supervisory authority and the supervisory authorities concerned

test_cases.question: What specific mechanism must the Chair ensure performs timely?
test_cases.answer: The Chair must ensure the timely performance of the tasks of the Board, in particular in relation to the consistency mechanism referred to in Article 63. This emphasizes the Chair's responsibility for ensuring the cross-border consistency procedures operate efficiently.
test_cases.supporting_quote: to ensure the timely performance of the tasks of the Board, in particular in relation to the consistency mechanism referred to in Article 63
